description: Run current whole-story proof and evidence-driven repair before local review.

steps.label: Establish the current whole-story proof boundary

content: Apply the proof-start operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Resolve the active plan and select or reuse its existing canonical final proof owner, not a stale current-task pointer. In that same task's Implementation Notes append one short fresh 'Whole-story proof start #N' boundary, where N is one greater than the greatest such boundary already recorded in that task. Record the plan and task identity and a concise description of the actual starting candidate, including relevant owned staged, unstaged and untracked changes, not just HEAD. Do not create a task, file, execution ID, or separate handoff. Preserve earlier boundaries and outcomes. Each new child invocation appends a new boundary, even for the same candidate; completed start steps are not repeated on resume. If interrupted start recovery cannot distinguish an already-written boundary from an earlier invocation using trustworthy resume evidence, do not guess or append another: fail this operation and report the boundary unavailable so dependent work does not adopt old evidence. Fail this operation if the boundary cannot be established. Do not start a competing proof writer or overwrite another owner's work. No proof execution, commit or push.

Apply the automated execution operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Resolve the current proof-start boundary and actual candidate afresh. On its first pass run all permitted applicable full suites and final-task lifecycle checks, invalidating stale checked proof honestly; on later passes run checks invalidated by material changes and independent permitted proof still due. Execute only; do not repair. Record terminal outcomes and failures against that boundary and candidate, and do not retry an unchanged failure.

steps.label: Leave automated loop when no actionable failure remains
steps.question: Apply the read-only decision operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Using the current proof-start boundary, actual candidate including owned working-tree changes, and matching outcomes, answer yes if no safely repairable in-scope automated failure remains, including unavailable evidence, genuine blockers and no-progress attempts. Answer no only for an actionable failure. Independent manual proof remains eligible. Return exactly {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}.

content: Apply the automated repair operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Diagnose matching terminal failure evidence and make the smallest authorized repair. The automated tester executes checks. Record changes, invalidated proof or the precise blocker/no-progress result against the current boundary and candidate.

steps.label: Stop automated repair without progress
steps.question: Apply the read-only decision operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Using the current boundary, actual candidate including owned working-tree changes, and matching repair evidence, answer no only if a material repair makes a safe affected automated check executable; otherwise answer yes, including unavailable evidence or genuine blockers. Return exactly {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}.

steps.label: Run applicable acceptance proof due for this boundary
steps.condition: Apply the read-only decision operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Resolve the current proof-start boundary, actual candidate including owned working-tree changes, scope and matching outcomes afresh. Return {"answer":"yes"} for the first applicable safe full-story manual pass under this boundary even when automated proof is blocked, absent or incomplete, provided the manual surfaces are independently executable. Also answer yes for safe scenarios invalidated by a later repair. Return {"answer":"no"} only when the boundary cannot be established, the applicable surfaces are excluded, human-only, unavailable or genuinely blocked, or their evidence is current. Do not infer a pass from prior boundaries or checked notes. Return exact JSON only.

then.label: Run whole-story acceptance proof or invalidated scenarios

content: Apply the full-story manual proof operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Perform one applicable full-story acceptance pass for the current proof-start boundary; after later repairs retest invalidated scenarios. Continue independently of blocked or absent automated proof where safe. Record actual candidate-tied outcomes and findings against the boundary, including partial, unavailable and human-only surfaces.

steps.label: Leave manual repair when no actionable finding remains
steps.question: Apply the read-only decision operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Using the current boundary, actual candidate including owned working-tree changes, and matching manual evidence, answer no only for an actionable, authorized finding with a safe repair not already attempted without progress. Otherwise answer yes, including missing, partial, excluded, human-only or blocked proof. Return exactly {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}.

content: Apply the manual-finding repair operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Repair only actionable authorized story-scope findings from the current boundary and candidate. Record actual changes, affected manual scenarios and invalidated automated checks, or precise blocker/no-progress evidence. Do not perform proof.

steps.label: Stop manual repair without progress
steps.question: Apply the read-only decision operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Using the current boundary, actual candidate including owned working-tree changes, and matching repair evidence, answer no only if a material repair has safe affected manual scenarios to retest. Otherwise answer yes, including unavailable evidence or genuine blockers. Return exactly {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}.

content: Apply the affected-scenario retest operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Reassess the current boundary, candidate and runtime, then retest the latest repair's affected scenarios and other invalidated acceptance surfaces. Record actual outcomes and remaining findings; do not repair or run automated suites.

steps.label: Finish when no changed candidate needs further proof
steps.question: Apply the read-only decision operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Using the current boundary, actual candidate including owned working-tree changes, and matching evidence, answer no only when a material repair has invalidated a permitted, safe executable automated check or manual scenario that still needs proof. Answer yes when none remains or remaining work is excluded, human-only, unavailable, genuinely blocked or unchanged after a no-progress attempt. Never treat missing evidence as a pass or rerun unchanged failures. Return exactly {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}.

content: Apply the proof outcome operation in $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/local_review_whole_story_proof.md. Report the current boundary and actual candidate, completed proof, failures and repairs, excluded or human-only surfaces, blockers and unavailable or stale evidence. Preserve the outcome in the existing plan or artifacts. Do not execute proof or claim missing evidence passed.
